newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Shenbao H1 net 2.85 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China's Shenbao H1 net 2.85 mln yuan.

text.p: China beverage maker Shenzhen Shenbao Industrial Co Ltd posted net profits of 2.85 million yuan for the first half of 1997, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said on Friday.

The company's per-share net was 0.017 yuan and net assets per share were 1.630 yuan based on a fully diluted basis after a 1997 bonus share issue, the exchange said in a notice issued after the market closed.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.
Shenbao booked net profits of 11.41 million yuan for the first half of 1996 based on Chinese standards. Figures based on international standards were not immediately available.
